note: Candidate sounds per ability moment, written by Claude from clip names, vanilla SoundDef use, length and brightness. Nothing here was listened to before it was written; pick by ear in the lab.

AG_GokuSolarFlare.note: One flash, no build-up: the anime cue is a sharp bright burst. Plays once at the flash.

options.label: EMP crackle up high + shield break sparkle

AG_GokuInstantTransmission.note: Anime: a short 'shun'. Two moments: leaving (on the 0.5 s start) and arriving.

options.label: Skip entry reversed feel: low + short

AG_GokuKamehameha.note: Three moments: the held charge (loops until Fire), the beam (1.2 s), and the hit where the beam ends.

moments.label: Charge (loop)
moments.when: channel 2.5 s, then hold until Fire

options.label: Synth: whine rising over the hum

moments.label: Beam
moments.when: Fire: the beam runs 30 cells for 1.2 s

moments.label: Beam end
moments.when: where the beam stops (wall or 30 cells)

AG_GokuSpiritBomb.note: Gather loop while channelling (no upper limit), a small cue each time a colonist lends energy, the throw, and the landing.

moments.label: Throw
moments.when: Throw pressed: the bomb moves to the target

AG_ThunderGodJump.note: The flash of the jump, then the cut (the melee hit already plays its own hit sound).

moments.label: Jump
moments.when: Minato leaves and appears at the mark

AG_ThunderGodChain.note: Same jump sound as the single jump, once per jump (every 0.24 s), so it needs to be short.

AG_GuidingThunder.note: Barrier up, and the redirect each time a shot is sent to the mark.

moments.label: Shot sent away
moments.when: each shot that comes out at the mark

AG_Rasengan.note: Anime: a whirring, rising spin, then a grinding impact. Forming is 0.6 s; the spin can loop if Minato has to walk to the target.

moments.label: Form (loop)
moments.when: 0.6 s forming, loops while he closes in

AG_SasukeAmenoyodomi.note: A toggle; the sound that matters is a weapon stopping dead in the air.

moments.label: Toggle
moments.when: each click to the next state

moments.label: Weapon stops in the air
moments.when: a thrown weapon stops over the cell

AG_SasukeAmenotejikara.note: Anime: an instant swap with a light 'ting'. Plays at both ends.

AG_SasukeRaikoKusari.note: Chidori through the net: an electric crackle when it links, and a crackle loop while it stands.

AG_SasukeAmaterasu.note: Black flame catching, then its own burn loop on the target.

AG_PainBanshoTenin.note: The pull (a push-wave run backwards), the flight, and the face-down slam.

moments.label: Pull
moments.when: cast: the target starts to slide

options.label: Animal pulser (the Gravity Well hum's clip)

AG_PainBlackReceiver.note: A rod thrown fast, and the stab.

AG_PainChibakuTensei.note: The core formed and thrown up, the 3 s tearing of the ground, and the compression at the end.

moments.label: Form + throw
moments.when: core between his hands, thrown up

moments.label: Tear (loop)
moments.when: 3 s of ground torn up and pulled in

AG_ItachiFalseFace.note: Genjutsu lands on everyone looking at him. A crow call is the Itachi signature; Odyssey has crows.

options.label: Crow call over a psychic pulse (Odyssey)

AG_ItachiSusanoo.note: Rise, the standing hum, the Yata Mirror turning a hit, and the Totsuka stab or seal.

AG_DispersalMurder.note: Plays Longjump_Jump now. Crows are the missing part.

AG_VergilJudgementCut.note: DMC: the draw and a ball of slices at the spot in the same instant, the ball breaking apart as it closes 0.5 s later, and the sheathe click with the break.

moments.label: Draw + cuts
moments.when: after the 0.6 s warmup: the draw, then 5 hits 0.1 s apart

moments.label: The ball breaks
moments.when: 0.5 s after the draw: it breaks into pieces that fall in, with a ring front and dust

moments.label: Sheathe click
moments.when: as the ball closes; the same sound ends Yamato Dash and Judgement Cut End

AG_VergilYamatoDash.note: Dash (0.15 s), then 0.4 s later the sheathe click (AG_VergilSheathe) and the cuts on every mark.

moments.label: Dash
moments.when: he crosses the ground in 0.15 s

moments.label: Cuts land
moments.when: with the click, only when someone was marked

AG_VergilSummonedSwords.note: Summon; in fire mode each blade flying (once a second) and going in; in spin mode a cut every 0.9 s; every blade breaking when the time is up.

moments.label: Blade flies
moments.when: fire mode: one blade a second

moments.label: Spin cut
moments.when: spin mode: one cut tick every 0.9 s on the pawns within 1.6 cells

moments.label: Every blade breaks
moments.when: when the time is up, the blades stuck in pawns too

AG_VergilJudgementCutEnd.note: Warmup (1 s), vanish with a storm of cuts (1.5 s), back kneeling, sheathe over 0.8 s; on the click (AG_VergilSheathe) everything is cut at once.

moments.label: Everything cut
moments.when: on the click, with the sheathe sound

AG_SatoSever.note: Cutting off a piece of himself and throwing it.

moments.label: Cut + throw
moments.when: the part comes off and is thrown

AG_SatoHeadshotReset.note: The shot to the temple, then the rise 6 s later (Satō's body re-forms).

AG_SatoGrenadeReset.note: The pin, a short hold, the blast (the explosion itself already has vanilla sound), then the rise at an anchor.

moments.label: Rise at anchor
moments.when: the body re-forms at the anchor

AG_SatoTheGame.note: Marking the next player to lose.

AG_SatoBlackGhost.note: Black matter pouring out and standing up, and the IBM tearing a limb off.

AG_ShadowImitation.note: The shadow running over the ground, then catching.

moments.label: Shadow runs out
moments.when: cast: the shadow crosses the ground

AG_ShadowGrasp.note: A hand of shadow dragging a thing over the ground.

AG_ShadowDouble.note: His shadow walks off and stands.

AG_ShadowNeckBind.note: Hands climbing (2.1 s), then the choke while he channels.

AG_Imperative_Stop.note: LarynxExtension.wordSound is already there and empty; this fills it. One word, everyone in hearing obeys.

AG_Imperative_Drop.note: LarynxExtension.wordSound is already there and empty; this fills it. One word, everyone in hearing obeys.

AG_Imperative_Come.note: LarynxExtension.wordSound is already there and empty; this fills it. One word, everyone in hearing obeys.

AG_Imperative_Run.note: LarynxExtension.wordSound is already there and empty; this fills it. One word, everyone in hearing obeys.

AG_Imperative_Crush.note: Heavier than the light words: 15 blunt to every listener.

options.label: No voice: shock lance + big animal hits

AG_Imperative_Explode.note: The explosions already have vanilla sound; this is only the word before them.

AG_Trace_UnlimitedBladeWorks.note: Each 2 s verse, the world opening (fire ring in the source), and the world closing.

moments.label: Verse
moments.when: each of up to three verses

AG_KamuiPhase.note: Toggle on/off, and a hit passing through him into the dimension.

moments.label: Hit goes through
moments.when: each hit that passes into Kamui

AG_KamuiWarp.note: Winding into his eye (1 s), and coming out of the swirl.

AG_KamuiStore.note: A person or item winding into his eye (0.4 s), and being put back.

AG_WoodRelease.note: Branches bursting out (0.5 s warmup) and skewering the line.

AG_VectorReflection.note: The world stops, and the rounds are sent back.

AG_VectorSurge.note: Five game seconds of a crawling world: a slowed-down loop fits.

AG_AnchorBlackFlash.note: Plays the vanilla punch now. Black Flash is a punch with a black spark.

moments.label: Black Flash hit
moments.when: the punch lands inside the window
